issues: Document has no ТР ТС / раздел section headings anywhere; tr_section is null for every row by design. Unit for row 1's water indicator is printed with a superscript exponent as 'Бк/л⁻¹' (transcribed as 'Бк/л-1'); this appears to be a typographic quirk of the source rather than a true per-liter-to-the-minus-one unit, kept as printed per rules. No rotated or illegible pages; OKPD2 and TN VED ЕАЭС codes are '-' (null) throughout.
